s1.syndrome_frame: Acute coronary syndrome with potential cardiac structural complication
salient_findings: Antero-septal STEMI treated with primary PCI and stenting
Mild LV dilation with reduced LVEF due to anterior/mid-septal and apical akinesia
Mass adherent to the ventricular surface of the anterior tricuspid leaflet
key_facts: Surgically repaired infra-renal abdominal aortic aneurysm
Unremarkable cardiovascular and respiratory findings on physical exam
Mild LV dilation (EDD 57 mm) on TTE
LVEF 46% due to anterior/mid-septal and apical akinesia
Sclerotic aortic and mitral leaflets with mild AR and moderate MR
9 mm round, hyperechoic mass adherent to the ventricular surface of the anterior tricuspid leaflet on TTE
TEE confirmed 6×8 mm non-solid structure on the ventricular aspect of the anterior tricuspid leaflet
Contrast-enhanced chest CT excluded pulmonary embolism

shortlist.label: Papillary fibroelastoma
shortlist.why_kept: Hyperechoic mass on the tricuspid valve with a 'finger-in-glove' appearance on TEE

shortlist.label: Lambl's excrescences
shortlist.why_kept: Possible cause of the mass on the tricuspid valve, given the patient's history of valve disease

shortlist.label: Veggetation due to infective endocarditis
shortlist.why_kept: Although blood cultures were negative, the mass on the tricuspid valve could be a vegetation

shortlist.label: Non-bacterial thrombotic endocarditis
shortlist.why_kept: Possible cause of the mass on the tricuspid valve, given the patient's history of malignancy or other risk factors

shortlist.label: Pseudotumor due to organized thrombus
shortlist.why_kept: The mass on the tricuspid valve could be a pseudotumor caused by an organized thrombus

raw.rationale: The description of a hyperechoic mass with a 'finger-in-glove' appearance and 'garland-like' elements on TEE is characteristic of papillary fibroelastoma, a benign cardiac tumor.

rejected.label: Lambl's excrescences
rejected.why: Lambl's excrescences are typically small, fibrous, and located on the aortic valve, which does not match the description of the mass in this case.

rejected.label: Veggetation due to infective endocarditis
rejected.why: Blood cultures were negative, and there is no other evidence of infection, making infective endocarditis unlikely.

rejected.label: Non-bacterial thrombotic endocarditis
rejected.why: The mass's characteristics do not suggest a thrombotic origin, and the patient does not have a known malignancy or other risk factors for non-bacterial thrombotic endocarditis.

rejected.label: Pseudotumor due to organized thrombus
rejected.why: The mass's appearance and mobility are not consistent with an organized thrombus, and the patient's clinical presentation does not suggest a thrombotic event.
